name: Dainichiseika Color & Chemicals Mfg. Co., Ltd.
summary: Dainichiseika Color & Chemicals Mfg. Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells powders, pigment dispersions, and functional materials in Japan, Asia, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Color & Functional Products; Polymers & Coating Materials; and Graphics & Printing Materials. It offers inorganic, organic, and prepared pigments for applications including paints, printing inks, and information display and recording materials; mass colorants for synthetic fibers, pigment printing agents, and colorants for paper and construction materials; and colorants for thermoplastic resins.
